officialPackages.mtimeMeaning: max mtime of a source file inside the package dir, from find -path '*/node_modules' -prune -o -type f -printf %T@ | sort -rn | head -1. node_modules is pruned so zod unpacking artifacts cannot masquerade as source changes.
